name: Hot Cowboy Summer
source:
Your boyfriend cheated on you! Now single, you decide to return to your father’s – but many things have changed.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你的男友背叛了你！恢复单身的你决定回到父亲的牧场——然而那里的许多事物早已物是人非。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
